summary: The remote control concept will combine ease of use and advanced features. Three controller concepts were discussed: Google controller (easy to use with sophisticated functions), fancy controller (attractive and recognizable), and intelligent controller (smart with speech and gesture recognition). The team agreed to work on a remote control with solar energy, batteries, and a wooden case.
